## Emissive

---

[Power Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Emissive)

Grants the entity an emissive texture similar to Allays and Glow Squids. The emissive light level is the __minimum__ light that the entity will appear at.

Type ID: `proviorigins:emissive`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
{
    "type": "proviorigins:emissive",
    "light": 15
}
```
Will make the player always appear at maximum brightness.
